_doc: Derivations registry (CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Every method has a derivation and a sympy proof'). routes: every derived CLI kind, analytic optimize/frequencies arm, CLI task = "md" kind (md:<kind>, from MD_KINDS) and Python entry point -> method ids. methods: book sections (book/src/<page>.md#<label>) plus sympy scripts, each run by a test under crates/ferric-python/tests. gaps: methods missing a piece, with the reason. Checked by crates/ferric-python/tests/test_derivation_registry.py.

entry_points: Python relativistic= on the SCF drivers

pbc-ks.reason: the energy functional, Fock convention, exxdiv and RS-GDF J/K are proven with pbc-hf (book sections #exchange-divergence and #rsgdf); the periodic XC grid quadrature and the XC force and stress terms have no book derivation and no sympy proof

xtb.reason: ferric adds no equations over libxtb (built with -Dtblite=disabled); appendix D describes the binding and derives nothing, and there is no sympy proof

u-ccsd-update-amps.reason: the per-spin factorization of ferric-cc/src/u_ccsd.rs::update_amps (PySCF uccsd.update_amps: per-spin F, the six W_ovvo ring blocks, the ladders) is not displayed in the book or transcribed in a script; u-ccsd proves the amplitude blocks, the energy split and the (T) classes, and the residual itself is held to the spin-orbital ccsd_uhf_spin_orbital solver amplitude by amplitude in Rust

rpa-gradient-metric-term.reason: rpa_gradient_sympy.py uses a unit RI metric, so the two-centre gamma term of the RI-dRPA gradient has no proof; the mp2_gradient_sympy.py part G non-unit-metric model is the one to reuse. Evidence is the Rust FD tests

ks-zvector-null-mode.reason: the null-mode projection of the KS Z-vector solve (zvector_ks.rs) has no sympy claim; ks_zvector_sympy.py proves the RKS/UKS/ROKS response equations on models without a null mode

linlccd-local.reason: linlccd with [local] (amplitude threshold): cc_triples_weights_and_linlccd_spin_adaptation_sympy.py proves the eps = 0 equations only; the pair gate and the truncation have no derivation or claim, and the Rust anchors are at eps = 0

pbc-ecp.reason: the periodic ECP lattice sum V_ECP(k) = sum_L e^{ikL} V^L, its transpose symmetry and the supercell unfolding are written down in 24.3, but the ECP energy, force and strain terms have no sympy proof (ferric-pbc/src/ecp.rs)

pbc-rsh.reason: only the range-separated Madelung constant is proven (claim rsh-madelung of scripts/pbc_ewald_pairft_stress_sympy.py); the attenuated periodic exchange of rsh.rs and gamma_rsh.rs, its force and its stress have no book derivation and no proof

pbc-mgga.reason: the periodic meta-GGA (gamma_mgga.rs and the k-point tau terms) energy, force and stress have no book derivation and no sympy proof

pbc-stress-xc-ecp-rsgdf.reason: step 5 of the stress assembly in 24.8: the XC, ECP and RS-GDF strain terms (stress.rs xc_stress, ecp_strain_term, the strained fit tensors) have no derivation and no proof; they are tested only against finite differences of ferric's own energy

pbc-rsgdf-options.reason: range_split and sr_column_rotation change which RS-GDF integrals are computed; 24.5 states them but there is no derivation of their equivalence to the unsplit fit and no sympy proof (gdf_omega = "auto" is proven: claim auto-omega-gcount of scripts/pbc_rsgdf_sympy.py)

pbc-kro-fock.reason: the k-point ROHF/ROKS effective Fock matrix on a mesh (kroks.rs) is not written in 24.6 and no claim covers it (kuhf-supercell is unrestricted)

ts-volume-ratio.reason: the Tkatchenko-Scheffler free-atom volume ratio that scales alpha and C6 in 25.2 and 25.3 has no sympy proof

mbd-gradient.reason: the MBD@rsSCS nuclear gradient through the Hirshfeld volumes and its Z-vector orbital relaxation have no book derivation and no sympy proof (only the coupled-dipole energy of 25.3 is proven)

drpa-local.reason: the masked Riccati solve is proven only in its exact limit (eps = 0, where it is the drpa method); no script or external reference checks the finite-threshold error model

ks-omega-tuning.reason: tune_omega runs the range-separated hybrid of ks-hybrid-rsh at several omega; the tuning criterion J(omega) (the ionization-potential condition) is a definition stated in book section #hybrids-tuning, and the golden-section bookkeeping (11 steps from 0.9 to 5e-3, the best evaluated point returned) is checked against PySCF there but transcribed in no sympy script
